forensic_analysis.key_finding: Model repeatedly selected e10 (username textbox) instead of e15 (Sign In button)
root_causes: Lexical similarity bias in local ranking
Old post-condition treated mechanical click as success
Recovery retry lacked explicit failure context
No local blocker against repeated failed actions
